basic_info.description: Bathed in natural light, this home blends generous scale with flexible living. The upper level features two spacious bedrooms and a well-appointed full bath, a large kitchen with an eat-up bar, and a true formal dining room that opens to the kitchen for easy flow. A sweeping living room with broad windows creates an inviting everyday hub and effortless space for entertaining. On the lower level, a thoughtfully configured space with its own bedroom, living area, kitchen, and bath offers optionsmultigenerational living, guest suite, or rental income to help offset the mortgage. Everyday conveniences continue with an attached garage providing direct interior access, plus laundry. Outside, a private, spacious yard extends the living area for gardening, play, or relaxed weekend gatherings. All of this sits just a few blocks from the shops and eateries along Noriega Street, with additional shopping and dining a short distance away on Irving, Noriega, and Taraval Streets.
